name: Bun ca ro dong
summary: Bún cá rô đồng is a noodle bowl of climbing perch from the former Hải Dương land now inside the city. It is not the center’s bún cá cay.
origin: The former Hải Dương land now inside Hai Phong, on the city portal’s 16 October 2025 account.
howToEat: Do not order it as bún cá cay.
where: The former Hải Dương side. No port street was named. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun ca ro dong — not Hai Phong’s bun ca cay
seoDescription: A climbing-perch noodle bowl from the former Hải Dương land now inside the city, not bún cá cay.
